title: Thurbox sessions
description: Thurbox's own session metrics: sessions by state, turns, waits on a human and lifecycle.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: The host.name of a Thurbox instance. Empty unless Prometheus promotes host.name.

list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.description: The coding agent a session runs.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Live sessions, in every state.

panels.title: Working
panels.description: Sessions whose agent is in a turn.

panels.title: Waiting on you
panels.description: Sessions blocked on a human: a permission prompt or a question.

panels.title: Done
panels.description: Sessions whose agent finished a turn you have not looked at.

panels.title: Idle
panels.description: Sessions at rest, or running background work.

panels.title: Failed, lost or unreachable
panels.description: A launch that failed, a pane that went with nobody asking, or a remote host that cannot be reached.

panels.title: Sessions by state
panels.description: Live sessions by the state word thurbox-cli session list shows.

panels.title: Sessions by agent
panels.description: Live sessions per coding agent.

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Turns that ended over the range. A turn runs from entering working to leaving it.

panels.title: Median turn
panels.description: Median turn over the range.

panels.title: p95 turn
panels.description: 95th percentile turn over the range.

panels.title: Median wait on you
panels.description: Median time a session stayed blocked on a human, over the range.

panels.title: Turn duration, trailing hour
panels.description: Turn quantiles over the hour before each point, from the histogram's buckets (1 s to 8 h).

panels.title: Wait on you, trailing hour
panels.description: How long sessions stayed blocked on a human, over the hour before each point.

panels.title: Turns by outcome
panels.description: Turns over the range by the state they ended in: done, blocked, idle or background.

panels.title: Mean turn by agent
panels.description: Mean turn per agent over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (clamp_min(last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_sum{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_sum{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[1d] offset $__range), 0) or last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_sum{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[$__range])) / sum by (agent) (clamp_min(last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_count{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_count{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[1d] offset $__range), 0) or last_over_time(thurbox_turn_duration_seconds_count{job="thurbox",host_name=~"$host",agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: State changes
panels.description: State changes over the range. An empty from is a session's first state.

panels.title: Lifecycle events
panels.description: Sessions spawned, stopped, lost, relaunched, deleted and more, over the range.

panels.title: Agent exits
panels.description: Agent processes that returned, by exit code, over the range.

panels.title: Median session lifetime
panels.description: Median time from creation to going, for sessions that went over the range.
